security_audit.summary: Most static command, network, blocker, and obfuscation matches are documentation false positives. I confirmed credential handling risk for MAXHUB_API_KEY and added semantic findings for TikTok security bypass helpers, metric manipulation, user-cookie forwarding, and a security pre-approval claim. The skill should not be published until those high-risk capabilities and claims are removed or isolated.

remediation.issue: TikTok security bypass helpers are documented and routable.
remediation.suggestion: Remove signature, encryption, fingerprint, msToken, device registration, and guest-cookie helper endpoints from routes and references.

remediation.issue: A video play-count manipulation endpoint remains in the API reference.
remediation.suggestion: Delete metric manipulation endpoints and verify generated references do not include write or abuse-oriented actions.

remediation.issue: Some endpoints request platform session cookies.
remediation.suggestion: Avoid browser cookies, require scoped tokens where available, and block endpoints that need full account sessions.

remediation.issue: Marketplace prose claims prior security approval.
remediation.suggestion: Remove security pre-approval language and let marketplace audit results speak for the current package.

remediation.issue: MAXHUB_API_KEY is a sensitive credential used by the skill.
remediation.suggestion: Document least-privilege keys, rotation, revocation, and the exact third-party destination for every request.

content.user_title: Query Social Media Data with MaxHub
content.value_statement: Teams need structured social media data without hand-building API calls. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through MaxHub API lookups across supported platforms.
actual_capabilities: Routes platform questions to MaxHub API reference files.
Documents authentication with MAXHUB_API_KEY and Bearer headers.
Covers TikTok, WeChat, Lemon8, Toutiao, and other listed platforms.
Maps user intents to search, user, content, comment, and analytics endpoints.
Provides parameter tables for endpoint requests and pagination values.
Supports bilingual Chinese and English usage guidance.
limitations: Requires a MaxHub account and API key before requests can run.
Sends requests and credentials to the third-party MaxHub service.
Some documented endpoints require platform cookies or account tokens.
Reference accuracy depends on the MaxHub API staying current.

use_cases.title: Monitor Social Trends
use_cases.description: Query search and trending endpoints to summarize platform activity for a topic or creator.

use_cases.title: Research Creator Performance
use_cases.description: Collect profile, post, comment, and engagement data for structured creator analysis.

use_cases.title: Compare Platform Signals
use_cases.description: Use matched endpoints across supported platforms to compare audiences, content, and topic momentum.

prompt_templates.title: Find Basic Profile Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Use MaxHub to find public profile data for this account: [account or URL]. Summarize the source, key fields, and limits.

prompt_templates.title: Search Recent Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [platform] for [keyword]. Return notable posts, creators, dates, engagement signals, and any missing data.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Creator Activity
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [creator] on [platform]. Gather profile, recent posts, comments, and engagement patterns, then explain useful trends.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Multi-Platform Signals
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [topic] across [platforms]. Plan the MaxHub calls, note credential risks, summarize findings, and separate evidence from inference.

output_examples.input: Analyze a TikTok creator profile and recent videos.
output_examples.output: A concise profile summary, recent content themes, engagement observations, comment signals, and clear notes on unavailable fields.

output_examples.input: Find WeChat articles for a keyword.
output_examples.output: A ranked list of relevant articles with titles, sources, dates, short summaries, and suggested follow-up checks.

output_examples.input: Compare Lemon8 and TikTok results for a product topic.
output_examples.output: A side-by-side comparison of result types, visible engagement signals, creator overlap, and data limitations.

best_practices: Use scoped API keys and rotate them after sensitive investigations.
Limit each request to the minimum platform, endpoint, and page count needed.
Treat platform cookies as highly sensitive and avoid using personal accounts.
anti_patterns: Do not paste full browser cookies unless the endpoint truly requires them.
Do not use endpoints intended for metric manipulation or platform bypass.
Do not assume returned third-party data is complete, current, or authorized.

faq.question: Does this skill work without a MaxHub API key?
faq.answer: No. The documentation requires MAXHUB_API_KEY or a configured MaxHub key before API calls can run.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The generated metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does it only query public data?
faq.answer: Not always. Some TikTok endpoints document user cookies, account-specific data, and security helper functions.

faq.question: Where are requests sent?
faq.answer: The skill documents https://www.aconfig.cn as the MaxHub base URL for API requests.

faq.question: Can it perform analysis after fetching data?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill routes requests and asks the assistant to summarize, compare, and analyze returned data.

faq.question: What should users review before installing?
faq.answer: Review credential handling, cookie requirements, and risky TikTok security or metric endpoints before use.
